scope: Static arithmetic/code evidence plus actual RTX2060 small operators, Embedding and complete fixed-budget public R1 RAG execution; not full R2 or formal acceptance

integer_gemm.direct_condition: sum of absolute products and every operand strictly below 2^52
integer_gemm.large_dot: x=2^16*floor(x/2^16)+low, low in [0,65535]; both partial sums <2^52; reconstruction bound (high_bound<<16)+low_bound <2^56

sum_guard_equivalence.node_pre_addition_bound: left/right each at most L+1; 2*(L+1)<2^56 for all locked RMS/L2 limits
sum_guard_equivalence.valid_row: if S<=L every partial sum is <=L, exact same integer total as fixed sequential scan
sum_guard_equivalence.invalid_row: if S>L at least one original fixed-scan addition would reject; both schedules set row_bad and then the whole input vector and sum to zero
sum_guard_equivalence.coordinate_failure: independent coordinate flag is ORed into row_bad; coordinate substitutes and complete-row final substitution are unchanged
sum_guard_equivalence.NR_substitute: failed RMS row uses A=F, L2 row_bad makes eligible false and uses x=0/A=F

actual_GPU_model_validation_scope: Two complete257-slot document Embeddings plus160-slot query; generation1024-slot28-layer prefill,255decode,256answer slots with30valid; numeric_failure=false, status0
independent_readonly_review: Crypto agent reviewed saturating-tree row-interface equivalence and high/low GEMM exactness, with registered L1/absolute-product-sum preconditions; this review is not CUDA execution evidence
log2_schedule: Six integer stages (32,16,8,4,2,1), constant tensor shape; x<=0 gives -1; positive power boundaries were checked on CUDA
resource_cleanup: Model close clears weight/cache dictionaries and callback cycle; pipeline and Embedding tool call close from finally on normal return or failure
startup_identity_binding: New operator/model tools capture profile/constants/quantized manifests/tokenizers/template/reference sources before computation and compare after completion; original three embedding records had only profile_id and are explicitly reviewed post-run
